message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands at the end of each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck (52 cards + 8 Wild + 8 Wild Draw Four).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **symbol**.
• **Number cards** (0‑9) match by number or color.
• **Action cards** (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two) match by color or symbol.
• **Wild** cards match any color. | | **Wild Cards** | • **Wild** – choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – choose the next color and force the next player to draw four cards. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Uno Call** | When you have one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can stack further. | | **No Wild Draw Four Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played at any time, ignoring the “no matching color” rule. | | **Custom Decks** | Uno offers themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack, Uno Spin) with additional mechanics. | **Key Strategy Tips** 1. **Keep a balanced hand** – avoid holding too many cards of one color.
2. **Use action cards wisely** – save them for when you’re about to win or to disrupt opponents.
3. **Watch opponents’ colors** – if you see someone discarding a color you have, you might want to play a Wild to change it.
4. **UNO call** – always remember to shout “UNO” when you’re down to one card. | That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to ask if you’d like deeper explanations on any rule or strategy.
